I proposed this idea awhile (~6 months) back and people seemed to like the idea; however, it never got implemented nor did the admins make any statement about being strictly against the idea.

That being said, I wanted to re-request a Discussion Contribution Points counter (DCP for short.)

DCP would be a count of how many people have commented on your submissions and comments. If you post a submission and 50 comments are made on it, you now have 50 DCP.

If you make a comment on something, every comment that stems directly off your comment gets you DCP. If someone replies to your comment and others reply to that comment, you don't get DCP for that.

##Commenting Example:

[Example](https://i.sli.mg/gohG2w.png)

In this instance, Bob would get 3 DCP since only three comments were in direct reply to his comment. Jack's reply to Bill will not be counted to Bob's DCP.

You can call Discussion Contribution Points whatever you want. I, personally, think it's a good way to show how much discussion a user has contributed to or started.

What do you think?
